highlights: Beliebtes Fotomotiv am Eingang zum Paznaun
tipps: Der beste Fotopunkt für Schloss Wiesberg und die Trisannabrücke befindet sich entlang der alten Paznauntalstraße.
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Wiesberg perches boldly above the deeply incised Trisanna gorge in Tobadill and forms a world-famous photo motif together with the Trisannabrücke.
beschreibung:
Bold Historic Monument above the Trisanna

The prominently visible Schloss Wiesberg is situated in the municipality of Tobadill at the gateway to the Paznauntal. Built in the 13th century, the castle complex perches on a striking rock ridge high above the confluence of the Trisanna and Sanna rivers.

Harmony of History and Engineering Feat

Together with the famous Trisannabrücke of the Arlbergbahn, the castle forms one of the most photographed ensembles in the province of Tirol. The historic castle is privately owned and particularly captivates walkers and hikers through its dramatic exterior architecture.
